title: TriAttention cache compaction at runtime
description: The native decoder pipeline updates the TriAttention cache, GPU kernels score candidates, host cache logic normalizes and aggregates scores and selects top rows, the default GPU path compacts those rows, and dynamic bindings change on a later step only when the selected row bucket changes.
subtitle: GPU scoring and row copies surround host-owned normalization, aggregation, and top-k selection.

messages.label: Prefill and decode update the model-owned cache
At each compaction boundary on the default GPU path
Before a decode step, only when the row bucket changes
Continue decoding until the request stops
